summary: Webhook health degraded (ai-sdlc-framework/ai-sdlc): no event for 110 min while a PR changed in the last 30 min

options.description: Restart the forwarder or re-register the hook
Stay poll-only and accept the gh call rate

body:
Webhook health is degraded: no event for 110 min while a PR changed in the last 30 min. Signals: {"receiver":true,"port":true,"lastEventAgeMin":110,"lastEventAt":"2026-11-27T23:47:43.034Z","receiverPort":8765,"prActivityWithoutEvent":true,"prActivity":true,"quiet":false,"forwarder":"alive","feed":"gh-forward"}. Dispatch keeps working by polling gh (about 2,700 calls an hour), which is the rate-limit pressure. Self-repair restarts the forwarder and removes its stale hook on its own; it could not restore deliveries. To fix by hand, restart the feed with `gh webhook forward --repo <owner>/<repo> --events pull_request,check_suite,check_run,workflow_run,status,pull_request_review --url http://127.0.0.1:8765/webhooks/github` and record it with `cli-hierarchy webhook up --feed gh-forward`, or re-register the repository hook (secret equal to AI_SDLC_WEBHOOK_SECRET). If the receiver itself is down run `cli-hierarchy webhook up`. Self-repair tried 3 time(s) and the feed is still not delivering: 2026-11-28T01:20:44.319Z reinstall ok (rewrote and reloaded com.ai-sdlc.webhook.dispatch-8c0ee5cb); 2026-11-28T01:26:07.408Z reinstall ok (rewrote and reloaded com.ai-sdlc.webhook.dispatch-8c0ee5cb); 2026-11-28T01:31:35.565Z kickstart ok (kickstart -k com.ai-sdlc.webhook.dispatch-8c0ee5cb after removing 1 stale cli hook(s)).
